name: Sump
description: Sump was an Outer Rim Territories planet located in the Koradin sector. It was the homeworld of the sentient Nuknog species. In 382 BBY, Sump was affected by a war fought between planets Eiram and E'ronoh of the Eiram system, and it consequently submitted multiple aid requests to the Galactic Republic.
